releases.name: Stygian: Outer Gods
releases.summary:
Set in the universe of Stygian: Reign of the Old Ones, the game lets players witness and influence the events preceding the Black Day. Immerse yourself in a unique world full of dangers, unexplored dark corners, and looming evil beyond mortal comprehension.

Assume the role of a mercenary accompanying the enigmatic girl to the foggy settlement of Kingsport to uncover her family’s dark secret. You are shipwrecked and soon encounter the nightmares that have haunted this place for centuries. 

Would you be able to find your way out, keep your sanity, and prevent the coming of the ancient Outer Gods, or maybe being insane is the key to salvation?

releases.name: Fangtopia
releases.summary:
Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

Build for beauty or aim for high scores, it’s entirely up to you.

releases.name: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
Demonfall Continent
releases.summary: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.

releases.name: Hot Mic
releases.summary: A party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 friends online. Bring a museum bust to life, rattle off a tongue twister and vote for the best cockerel impression. Light your mic on fire!

releases.name: Tetheg
releases.summary: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

releases.name: Arctic Adventure
releases.summary: The story of a polar bear's journey—leaving the Arctic to take up surfing in search of his uncle. Featuring cute pixel art, simple controls, a touching narrative, and challenging gameplay!

releases.name: Taskbar Parade
releases.summary: A desktop companion game: a tiny parade of cute animals walks along the top of your taskbar while you work. Pet them, catch sparkles on the road, grant their daily wishes, send them exploring, and collect hats, friends and souvenirs. Quiet by default — it never gets in the way.

releases.name: Spook & Sell
releases.summary: Stage the haunt. Sell the house. You’re the world’s most desperate real-estate agents — hide the ghosts, mop the ectoplasm, and keep buyers calm in this chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics party game before the haunting meter tips over.

releases.name: RE:COPY
releases.summary: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

releases.name: Shawarma Karma
releases.summary: Run a blood powered console company through 13 weeks of investors, scandals, negotiations, layoffs, promises, crises, and increasingly terrible business decisions. Keep the board happy. Keep Shawarma happy... Keep the customers quiet. Keep your job?

releases.name: One More Brick
releases.summary: A cozy incremental brick breaker on a scribbled sketchbook page. Smash bricks, collect the rewards, and buy upgrades until balls split, lasers fly, and the page gets wonderfully messy. Grow your skill tree, put the Infinite Breaker to work, and turn over a new page.
